styleResult: Grounded rocks, cloth, plants, wood and weathered metal, natural outdoor lighting and restrained surface rendering remain compatible with actual approved Genesis 7 style. Blues/greens, purple/scarlet, white linen and red moon/haze vary color. Chapter 21 reflective gold and chapter 4 glass facets follow visionary material imagery; no demand that visionary material be ordinary scenery.
textualIdentityLimits: John on Patmos is not portrayed. Title/authorship does not certify an apostolic portrait, date or age. Apostle John differs from Baptist/John Mark; precise Gospel named face mapping remains uncertain.

Jesus, the Lamb, cloud-seated son-of-man figure, angels, elders, witnesses, woman, bride, Michael, dragon, beasts, nations and armies are not portrayed. No anonymous Daniel figure is assigned Michael. Symbolic witnesses are not identified as Moses/Elijah by an unsupported face map.
KJV/WEB I stood versus ASV he stood in 13:1 is retained; no figure resolves the edition difference. KJV vials versus ASV/WEB bowls in 15:7 remains unchanged.
Seven seals, two trees/two lampstands and seven bowls counted. Other frames are selected motifs, not complete censuses of every visionary object.
No literal coast/map/date, revealed scroll wording, exact architecture or feast menu certified. No present-day city identified as Babylon.
